author: Mira and Tolvald
pages:
M: We are free. It rained all night and the tent leaks and I have never been happier.

T: Her father will send men after us. Mine will send a letter, which is worse.

M: Tomorrow we cross the river and no one will know us on the other side.

T: I have left my old name under a stone by the fire. If anyone asks, we were never here.
